visible_baseline_solution.text: From screenshots, the agent sees a 1000 by 580 room, brown platforms/shelves, four gold seals, a parcel, and full-mode body arrows. At d3 the parcel starts on a central island; a visible gap leads to a landing and upper shelves leave a visible opening. Fixed area makes the parcel narrower when taller and wider when shorter. The agent must choose a route, reshape to contact elevated seals, flatten enough to bridge unsupported space, manage drift, and fit through the shelf/well geometry. Each 40 ms tick applies morphing, acceleration, damping, gravity, collision/landing, and contact checks; release/coast leaves physics active, so recent movement informs the next input. Contact tolerance is a 10-unit radius and AABB clearance/bounds also matter. A fall ends the room; NEW ROOM requests a fresh room. All four seals must be collected before CERTIFY, whose transcript is independently replayed.

baseline_judgment.rationale: The current island profile is materially above the approved L1 voxel and L2 constellation tasks because movement, support, shape, and contact decisions depend on a continuous physical state. It is close to approved L3 Gyroscopic Tilt Board closed-loop control, but below approved L4 Blind Dice Courier's hidden orientation/gate dependency and approved L5 Exact-Change Candy Cascade's changing-board exact-score dependency. Keep d3/full provisionally; this is source evidence, not empirical calibration or an approved-anchor designation.

concise_summary: Source review supports keeping Concertina Courier at configured difficulty 3/full and retaining five relative profiles. d1-d2 add support/shape dependence, d2-d3 changes topology, and d3-d5 tighten local control geometry. Full and Simplified preserve world, visible information, physics, timing, tolerances, and success while binding different input transcripts. The placement remains provisional because alcove is inactive and higher profiles have mixed geometry effects.
